description: Chrome proportion shrink-only ratchet baseline (tempdoc 697). ONE authority for the per-ui-shot-step persistent-chrome elements whose rendered HEIGHT must not GROW beyond a recorded ceiling (maxHeightPx). Shrinking is always allowed; growth beyond maxHeightPx + tolerancePx is a violation, enforced by `jseval ui-proportion-gate` (which reuses the ui-shot `.measure.json` geometry — see scripts/jseval/jseval/ui_measure.py). Regenerate via scripts/jseval/experiments/regen_proportion_baseline.py. ACTIVE (tempdoc 697 activation): both target elements were DATA-DEPENDENT (a degraded readiness verdict for the collapsed pill; a rendered turn for the one-line user bubble) and are now captured deterministically by the dedicated isolated `chat-proportion` ui-shot step (scripts/jseval/jseval/ui_check.py), which installs the `degraded` fixtures variant (ui_fixtures._status_body — flips `readiness.composites.retrieval` to DEGRADED with `worker.health.embedding_not_ready`, a 'warn'-severity LifecycleReasonCode so the banner renders collapsed) and actually submits a chat turn (a `?`-bearing draft + Enter, escalating to UnifiedChatView.send()). `chat-mode` (the shared chain step) is untouched — it documents chat-INPUT mode only and never submits, so it was not repurposed. Both elements' `maxHeightPx` were filled in by regen_proportion_baseline.py from this step's live `--fixtures` capture; with the top-level `tolerancePx` of 2px folded in, the effective ceilings are 44px (pill) and 38px (bubble).
captureState: ui-shot --fixtures (deterministic); the `chat-proportion` isolated step (degraded status fixture + a submitted chat turn) — see tempdoc 697; the `chat-occlusion` isolated step (1050x800, document pane opened, an 8-toast burst) — see below
constraintKinds: An element declares at least one of: `maxHeightPx` (shrink-only chrome ratchet, tempdoc 697); `minWidthPx` (a FLOOR for primary content that surrounding chrome must not starve); `mustNotOverlapSelector` (two rects must not intersect — occlusion, which no per-element size budget can express). Enforced by `jseval ui-proportion-gate`; an element with no constraint, or a selector missing from the captured geometry, is an ERROR, never a silent pass.
occlusionNote: Sandbox round 7 registered two layout defects on the `chat-occlusion` capture. (1) `.conversation` — the RAG reading column measured 102px wide (about one word per line) at 1050x800 with the document pane open, because CONVERSATION_ZONES declared its grid track `minmax(0, 50rem)` while its neighbours reserved real min-widths; the track floor is now 24rem, so the floor here is 384px. (2) `.toast` vs `.header` — the OverlayHost `.top-right` column docked at 48px, inside the chat surface's 56-88px header band, completely covering the shape badge; the dock now clears the surface header row as well as the topbar. HONEST RESIDUAL: three components share that slot (jf-provenance-badge, jf-advisory-toast-host, jf-plugin-error-overlay), each unaware of the others' height, so the slot's total DOWNWARD growth is bounded only per-component (the toast host caps at 3 + a `+N earlier` row) — it is not solved at the slot.
